races.verdict: ROYAL RHYTHM had plenty to spare at Worcester and a 9 lb rise may not stop him if able to string 2 decent efforts together. Jefe Triunfo could pose a threat if recapturing the form he showed in these refitted cheekpieces last autumn, while Clever Relation may benefit from the longer trip. ROYAL RHYTHM (IRE) JEFE TRIUNFO (FR) CLEVER RELATION
races.betting_forecast: Royal Rhythm (2/5), Clever Relation (13/2), Jefe Triunfo (10/1), County Champs (10/1), Kings Order (16/1), Atreides (25/1)
